answer: To reach the summit of voting weight, an attacker would need to acquire and stake many distinct devices, and any cluster of colluding identities loses its stake upon detection. Each agent must stake quartz tokens bound to a unique hardware root, and reputation climbs a vine only through peer-attested work. This makes mass fake identities economically ruinous, since the cost of genuine hardware and slashed deposits far exceeds any reward from a sybil swarm. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
